name: q8_fly_reservoir_level0
purpose: Pure-fly language substrate: the complete MaleCNS v1.0 adult male CNS wiring (165,122 neurons, 25,563,096 signed synapses, spectral radius normalized to 1) is frozen and never trained; dynamics are the biology's own (LIF: leak 0.9, threshold 0.1, signed synapses per neurotransmitter convention). Language enters as a learned broadcast projection into every neuron and leaves through a learned weighted readout over all neurons into a tied decoder.

training.trained: input projection, weighted readout, tied embedding only
training.state_rule: reservoir state persists across chunks and updates; never reset

evaluation.note: state from zero + warm-in (an LIF substrate has no NESS spectrum)

ladder.level2: local plasticity rules instead of gradient descent

collapse_note: The frozen wiring is immune to the spatial collapse that hit the learned torus line: no objective can flatten an untrained structure.
